name: luatikz
description: Fast LuaLaTeX TikZ rendering with full library support, live preview, RTL support, and simple diagram helpers.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-tikzjax-tex-assets.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/validate-tikzjax-bundle.mjs
scripts.test:tikzjax: node scripts/test-tikzjax-normalize.mjs && node scripts/test-render-routing.mjs && node scripts/test-tikzjax.mjs && node scripts/test-tikzjax-mobile-sim.mjs && node scripts/test-error-mapping.mjs && node scripts/test-line-mapping.mjs && node scripts/test-source-validation.mjs && node scripts/test-tikz-snippets.mjs && node scripts/test-structural-lint.mjs && node scripts/test-coordinate-pick.mjs && node scripts/test-statement-geometry.mjs && node scripts/test-fence-starter.mjs && node scripts/test-preamble-and-hints.mjs && node scripts/test-decoration-styles.mjs
